descriptor.name: Tanzania e-Ardhi current TP Drawing spatial units
descriptor.operator: United Republic of Tanzania Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development
descriptor.attribution: Tanzania Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development e-Ardhi · TP Drawing / current town-plan spatial units
descriptor.scope: Bounded technical qualification around the unchanged UN WUP 2025 Mwanza settlement locator. The official viewer labels current_tp_spatial_units as TP Drawing. These are planning-survey spatial footprints; the evidence does not establish that each is a legal cadastral parcel, parcel title, a complete city set, or a current authoritative municipal boundary.
descriptor.licenceNote: WFS capabilities advertise Fees=NONE and AccessConstraints=NONE. An explicit reuse licence and attribution conditions were not located; retain Ministry attribution and keep runtime admission held pending terms review.

evidence: The official e-Ardhi viewer maps taspro:current_tp_spatial_units to TP Drawing.
The layer is qualified here as parcel-scale town-plan / planning-survey footprints only; no claim is made that it represents legal cadastral parcels or title boundaries.
First-party WFS DescribeFeatureType exposes uid and geom; this candidate requests only those source values.
